camel_example: aliyun dbfs CreateAutoSnapshotPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --TimePoints '["\"01\""]' --PolicyName policyTest --RetentionDays 30 --RepeatWeekdays '["\"1\""]' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --version 2020-04-18 --method POST --force
description_en: Creates an automatic snapshot policy in a specified region. The automatic snapshot policy periodically creates snapshot backups for database file systems
description_zh: 在指定地域下创建一条自动快照策略。自动快照策略可以周期性地为数据库文件系统创建快照备份数据
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs create-auto-snapshot-policy --policy-name policyTest --retention-days 30 --repeat-weekdays '["\"1\""]' --time-points '["\"01\""]' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAutoSnapshotPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The list of days of the week on which to create automatic snapshots. Valid values: 1 to 7. For example, 1 indicates Monday. Format description:

The parameter must be in JSON array format. For example, ["1"] indicates that automatic snapshots are created every Monday.

If you want to create automatic snapshots multiple times a week, you can specify multiple days. Separate the days with commas (,). You can specify up to 7 days. For example, ["1","3","5"] indicates that automatic snapshots are created every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday
parameters.help_zh:
自动快照的重复日期列表，单位为天，周期为星期。取值范围：1~7，例如1表示周一。格式说明：

传入的参数需要保持JSON数组格式。例如，["1"]表示每周一重复创建自动快照。

当一星期内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，时间点之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多传入7个时间点。例如，["1","3","5"]表示每周一、周三、周五重复创建自动快照
parameters.name: repeat_weekdays

parameters.help_en:
The list of points in time at which to create automatic snapshots. The time is in UTC+8 and measured in hours. Valid values: 0 to 23, which represent the 24 points in time from 00:00 to 23:00. For example, 01 indicates 01:00. Format description:

The parameter must be in JSON array format. For example, ["1"] indicates that automatic snapshots are created at 01:00.

If you want to create automatic snapshots multiple times a day, you can specify multiple points in time. Separate the points in time with commas (,). You can specify up to 24 points in time. For example, ["01","03","15"] indicates that automatic snapshots are created at 01:00, 03:00, and 15:00
parameters.help_zh:
自动快照的创建时间点列表。使用UTC +8时间，单位为小时。取值范围：0~23，代表00:00至23:00共24个时间点，例如01表示01:00。格式说明：

传入的参数需要保持JSON数组格式。例如，["1"]表示01:00创建自动快照。

当一天内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，时间点之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多传入24个时间点。例如，["01","03","15"]表示01:00、03:00、15:00时创建自动快照
parameters.name: time_points

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id
